'''Tayan staffs''' were objects used by the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priests]] of the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] religion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The staffs shared their name with [[Taya]], an avatar of the Doellinist [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Doellin]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tayan staffs were mentioned in the [[2015]]<ref name="Grounds for Rebellion">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/11/12/grounds-for-rebellion|text=Grounds for Rebellion}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
